messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-98213 - gpu-memory-pressure - severity: high - 3/5 pools above kernel alloc failure threshold :rotating_light:
pagerduty: @maria (oncall) paged (minutes: 0) - link: https://pd.example/PD-98213
maria (oncall): acked. i'm on it — checking pools and recent deploys.
kevin: seeing a small spike in evictions in the kvcache metrics, could be fragmentation.
raj: oncall handoff is in 20m — if this looks like an hours thing, start thinking handoff plan.
maria (oncall): quick check: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/pool/gpu-pool-a | jq .mem.used | tail -n1` shows steady climb.
kevin: running `ssh gpu-node-17 -- nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` now, will paste output if anything obvious.
eng-sre-bot: autoscaler triggered +1 node for gpu-pool-a at 10:03:45 UTC (scale op id: sc-4382).
inc snapshot (maria): recent deploy? none in last 2 hours.
kevin: nvidia-smi output: 
```
GPU 0: 24576 MiB total, 24102 MiB used, 474 MiB free
Processes:
  python (pid 4321) 12000 MiB
  python (pid 5400) 11500 MiB
```
kevin: looks like two runaway python procs on same GPU - maybe KV cache compaction didn't free correctly.
maria (oncall): can we try targeted restart of the pod on that node? will drain if safe. which model variant hitting it? checking traces...
olivia: traffic shows high ~token-per-request from customer-key: CUST-ACME-001, root cause might be long-context batch reruns. throttling recommended.
raj: i'll prepare canary routing to fallback-model-cpu to reduce GPU pressure. needs a quick route update and a config change in routing service.
maria (oncall): moving 10% of requests to fallback now. `POST /admin/routing` payload: `{ "route":"/v1/generate","pct":10,"target":"fallback-cpu-v1" }`
kevin: restarting problematic pod: `kubectl delete pod gpu-runner-17-7f9d -n inference` — pod terminated, kube will reschedule (graceful: 30s).
incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: attempted restart of offending pod; autoscaler +1; reroute 10% to fallback-cpu-v1.
maria (oncall): watching evictions and OOM logs. `journalctl -u inference-gpu --since "1 minute ago" | grep -i oom` shows kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 5400 (python) total-vm: 24G
kevin: after restart, gpu-node-17's used memory dropped to 6GB. reclaim successful.
olivia: customer CUST-ACME-001 saw 504s during the initial spike but error rate is down by 70% since route change. I'm sending a quick customer note.
raj: we should increase kv-cache eviction aggressiveness for this pool as a short-term mitigation. `kvcachectl set --pool gpu-pool-a --evict-threshold 0.6`
maria (oncall): applied `kvcachectl` change to 0.6. watching for side effects.
eng-sre-bot: policy-trigger: auto-shedder engaged for gpu-pool-a; shedding older prefixes.
kevin: metrics: reclaim + route change + autoscale => steady decrease in free memory pressure over next 90s.
maria (oncall): prepping handoff to raj in ~10m. Will document actions in incident ticket PD-98213 and Slack thread.
raj: taking over from maria in 10m. if pressure flares again, escalate to infra-eng for live node debug.
maria (oncall): handing off: summary -> PD-98213; root cause suspected: kvcache fragmentation + long-context batch rps from CUST-ACME-001; mitigations applied: pod restart, autoscale +1, 10% reroute to fallback-cpu-v1, kvcache eviction increased to 0.6.
kevin: adding note: possible cleanup task to avoid co-locating two heavy python processes on same GPU slot. open follow-up: INF-4057.
olivia: customer ops update sent to CUST-ACME-001: short blip, partial failover to CPU fallback, monitoring; will follow up with RCA.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98213 status changed to acknowledged by maria (oncall) at 10:05:12 UTC.
pagerduty: reminder: if unresolved in 30m, will escalate to secondary pager.
raj: quick Q — should we keep 10% reroute or bump to 25% until kvcache compaction finishes?
maria (oncall): bump to 25% for now; apply change.
kevin: applied 25% reroute. latency on fallback is higher but error rate drops.
eng-sre-bot: observed no new kernel alloc failures for 5m after changes.
maria (oncall): good. i'm going to remove myself from pager in 10m and hand to raj. leaving the channel.
raj: ack to take full pager. will open follow-up incident ticket for long-term config changes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98213 auto-resolve check passed: no new alerts for 15m. marking as resolved?
maria (oncall): confirming resolution, thanks all.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98213 resolved at 10:21:39 UTC. auto-note: actions recorded -> restart, autoscale, reroute, kvcache tweak, follow-up INF-4057.
kevin: filing post-incident item and adding logs to ticket.
olivia: customer notified of resolution.
raj: will run postmortem draft tomorrow AM.
maria (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup:
